pagerduty-bot: [1976543211] ALERT: hosted-inference-us-west-2: latency spike > 500ms (escalation policy: inference-critical)
incidentbot: PagerDuty incident PD-85231 triggered -> primary: eva (oncall) -> secondary: maria (sre-manager) -> manager: on-call-manager
pagerduty-bot: page sent (primary) via push and SMS
eva (oncall): on it, checking dashboards :eyes:
incidentbot: 60s -> no ack from eva
pagerduty-bot: attempting SMS -> delivery_failed (reason: "sms_bounced") to +1-***-***-4242
incidentbot: SMS bounce for secondary candidate maria detected — escalating to manager per policy :rotating_light:
maria (sre-manager): getting the page but my phone is on DND for surgery today, will try manager bridge from laptop shortly
tim (support): customer reports coming in: "our embeddings requests are timing out" — ticket #8742 opened
raj (eng-oncall): joining, can someone paste top controller logs?
ops-bot: logs tail:
```
[2026-03-15T01:12:34Z] inference.router: accept_rate=0.98 errors_per_min=45 p50=120ms p95=680ms p99=1250ms
[2026-03-15T01:12:36Z] host-usw2-23: evicting_kv_cache=true, worker-3 OOM-restart
[2026-03-15T01:12:38Z] autoscaler: failed_to_spin_up_instance: quota_exceeded
```
eva (oncall): seeing KV cache thrash + one noisy host OOMing, autoscaler queue stalled — suspect CVM quota bump failed
incidentbot: 6m -> manager escalation fired to on-call-manager -> bridge creation attempt
pagerduty-bot: called manager contact number for maria -> left voicemail (no answer)
incidentbot: fallback: broadcast to oncall-rotation channel and pinging eng-oncall
raj (eng-oncall): ack
raj (eng-oncall): can confirm autoscaler couldn't request new GPUs due to cloud quota error, temporarily increased capacity by rebalancing existing dedicated pool
eva (oncall): running pre-approved mitigation: set `inference.shed_load=true` on noisy route, enabled slow-path model variant (v-short) to reduce memory pressure
```
# commands run
> curl -X POST https://console.internal/redwood/ops/mitigate -d '{"route":"/v1/generate","mode":"shed"}'
> /pd-silence PD-85231 30m --reason "auto-fallback in place"
```
maria (sre-manager): on laptop now, joining the bridge (audio poor) — thanks for the quick mitigation
tim (support): customer impact estimate: ~3% of production requests in us-west-2 had >=1 retry or 504 between 01:11-01:20 UTC, top affected SKU: embeddings (hosted tier). Notifying top-10 impacted customers now.
raj (eng-oncall): rolling restart of host-usw2-23 completed, KV cache warmup in progress, p95 down to 180ms
incidentbot: PD escalation chain closed (secondary unreach due to SMS bounce), incident marked "acknowledged by eng-oncall"
eva (oncall): confirming traffic shifted and shedding worked — errors dropping
ops-bot: metrics snapshot link: https://grafana.internal/d/abc/hosted-inference?from=1976543000&to=1976543300
maria (sre-manager): good run. action items:
- investigate SMS provider bounce for manager contact (owner: ops, due 2026-03-17)
- add playbook step: if SMS bounce detected -> auto-call backup number (owner: oncall infra, due 2026-03-16)
- quota monitoring: alert on cloud quota saturation earlier (owner: infra-team, due 2026-03-18)
- customer follow-ups for top affected accounts (owner: tim, due 2026-03-15)
raj (eng-oncall): filed follow-up ticket INF-2932 with logs and temp fixes applied
tim (support): sent initial outbound to impacted customers: templated notice + support contact
eva (oncall): putting final status update in PD and closing thread after 10m of stable metrics
incidentbot: incident PD-85231 -> status: mitigated, duration: 9m (ack by raj at 1976543270)
maria (sre-manager): small note — manager bridge had audio weirdness; ops to validate conference bridge provider as well
eva (oncall): thanks everyone :heart: — reopening if regressions happen
pagerduty-bot: automated post-incident survey sent to oncall and manager
incidentbot: logged thread to /incidents/1976543211 for postmortem draft
